name: unidrop-monorepo
description: UniDrop - Secure QR-Based Peer-to-Peer File Transfer System for University Computer Labs

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
